keyword: how long does it take a rocket to get to the moon
claims: Traveling from Earth to the Moon by rocket typically takes about three days.
The standard transit time for crewed missions such as the Apollo program is about three days.
Apollo 8's travel time from Earth to the Moon was just under 3 days.
Apollo 11's travel time from Earth to the Moon was just under 3 days.
Travel times for modern missions to the Moon are several days.
